$comment: High/critical npm advisories accepted by scripts/audit-gate.mjs. Each entry needs a GHSA id, the package npm reports it on, why it cannot reach Polaris, and an expiry date - an expired entry fails the gate again. Background and removal conditions: docs/dependencies.md.

accepted.reason: No fixed node-forge release (<=1.4.0, the latest). Pulled in by acme-client, which only uses forge to generate keys, build CSRs and parse PEM; it never verifies an RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature, the only affected function.

No fixed release. Reached only through whatsapp-web.js -> puppeteer -> proxy-agent, which uses FTP to download a browser; the bridge image sets PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD and runs the system Chromium, so no FTP listing is ever parsed.

No fixed release. Used only by @puppeteer/browsers to unpack a downloaded browser; the bridge never downloads one (PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD, system Chromium), and Polaris extracts no user archive with it.

No fixed release. Used only by @puppeteer/browsers to unpack a downloaded browser; the bridge never downloads one (PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD, system Chromium), and Polaris extracts no user archive with it.

No fixed release. Build- and install-time only: tailwindcss 3 and patch-package expand glob patterns written in this repository (content paths, patch file names), never a pattern from a request. The copy under dymo-api's tw-to-css sits on the SDK's sendEmail path, which Polaris never calls.

Two exact pins of 8.4.31 the root override does not reach: Next.js 15 (build time, on this repository's own stylesheets; fixed only in Next 16) and tw-to-css inside dymo-api, used only by the SDK's sendEmail path, which Polaris never calls.

Exact pins in @excalidraw/excalidraw (3.3.3), @excalidraw/mermaid-to-excalidraw (4.0.2) and @univerjs/core 0.25 (5.1.11). Each calls nanoid() with a fixed positive size, never a negative one. Excalidraw is being replaced by the in-house diagram editor; Univer 1.x drops nanoid.

Exact pins in @excalidraw/excalidraw (3.3.3), @excalidraw/mermaid-to-excalidraw (4.0.2) and @univerjs/core 0.25 (5.1.11). None calls a custom generator with size 0. Excalidraw is being replaced by the in-house diagram editor; Univer 1.x drops nanoid.

Exact pins in @excalidraw/excalidraw (3.3.3), @excalidraw/mermaid-to-excalidraw (4.0.2) and @univerjs/core 0.25 (5.1.11). Sizes are small constants, nowhere near the integer overflow. Excalidraw is being replaced by the in-house diagram editor; Univer 1.x drops nanoid.

chevrotain 11 pins lodash-es 4.17.21 (via mermaid, only through @excalidraw/mermaid-to-excalidraw). The flaw is in _.template with attacker-chosen import keys; chevrotain never calls _.template. Goes away with Excalidraw.
